177	async def so_line_open_to_deliver(
178	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, order_line_id: uuid.UUID
179	) -> Decimal | None:
180	    """The still-open-to-deliver quantity on an order line — ORDERED minus DELIVERED — or None if
181	    the line does not exist (PLAN 7.2 → 7.3). A delivery (7.3) caps a pick at this. A point lookup
182	    on
183	    the maintained ``delivered_quantity`` (raised by 7.3), not a SUM over deliveries."""
184	    line = (
185	        await session.execute(
186	            select(SalesOrderLine).where(
187	                SalesOrderLine.tenant_id == tenant_id,
188	                SalesOrderLine.id == order_line_id,
189	            )
190	        )
191	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
192	    if line is None:
193	        return None
194	    return Decimal(str(line.ordered_quantity)) - Decimal(str(line.delivered_quantity))
195	
196	
197	async def get_order_for_delivery(
198	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, order_id: uuid.UUID
199	) -> tuple[SalesOrder, list[SalesOrderLine]] | None:
200	    """The order header + its lines (item, ordered/delivered quantities, unit price, tax code) — the
201	    data a delivery (7.3) needs to build pick lines and billing (7.4) needs to invoice. None when
202	    the
203	    order is unknown to this tenant. Two indexed reads (header by PK, lines by (tenant, order_id));
204	    no
205	    N+1 over lines."""
206	    order = await get_sales_order(session, tenant_id, order_id)
207	    if order is None:
208	        return None
209	    lines = list(
210	        (
211	            await session.execute(
212	                select(SalesOrderLine)
213	                .where(
214	                    SalesOrderLine.tenant_id == tenant_id,
215	                    SalesOrderLine.order_id == order_id,
216	                )
217	                .order_by(SalesOrderLine.line_number)
218	            )
219	        )
220	        .scalars()
221	        .all()
222	    )
223	    return order, lines
224	
225	
226	# --- ATP: committed quantity + the availability check (PLAN 7.2, D-044) -----------------------
227	
228	
229	async def committed_quantity(
230	    session: AsyncSession,
231	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
232	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
233	    *,
234	    exclude_order_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
235	) -> Decimal:
236	    """The quantity of an item COMMITTED by confirmed-but-undelivered sales orders (PLAN 7.2, D-044)
237	    — the reservation an ATP scan subtracts from on-hand. Sums ``ordered − delivered`` over order
238	    lines for ``item_id`` on CONFIRMED / PARTIALLY_DELIVERED orders (a CONFIRMED order has reserved
239	    its undelivered quantity; a DRAFT / CREDIT_BLOCKED / CANCELLED / fully-DELIVERED / INVOICED /
240	    CLOSED order commits nothing). ``exclude_order_id`` drops one order from the sum — used when
241	    confirming so an order's own demand is checked against availability NET of other commitments.
242	
243	    SET-BASED (no per-order N+1, PERFORMANCE §2): one join over order lines filtered by the order's
244	    status + a positive open quantity, summed in PYTHON over the (small) open set so the
245	    exact-decimal
246	    QuantityType round-trips identically on both engines (D-015: SQL never subtracts two scaled
247	    quantity columns for the result value)."""
248	    stmt = (
249	        select(SalesOrderLine.ordered_quantity, SalesOrderLine.delivered_quantity)
250	        .join(
251	            SalesOrder,
252	            (SalesOrderLine.tenant_id == SalesOrder.tenant_id)
253	            & (SalesOrderLine.order_id == SalesOrder.id),
254	        )
255	        .where(
256	            SalesOrderLine.tenant_id == tenant_id,
257	            SalesOrderLine.item_id == item_id,
258	            SalesOrder.status.in_(
259	                [
260	                    SalesOrderStatus.CONFIRMED.value,
261	                    SalesOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_DELIVERED.value,
262	                ]
263	            ),
264	            SalesOrderLine.delivered_quantity < SalesOrderLine.ordered_quantity,
265	        )
266	    )
267	    if exclude_order_id is not None:
268	        stmt = stmt.where(SalesOrder.id != exclude_order_id)
269	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
270	    return sum(
271	        (Decimal(str(ordered)) - Decimal(str(delivered)) for ordered, delivered in rows),
272	        Decimal(0),
273	    )
274	
275	
276	@dataclass(frozen=True)
277	class AtpResult:
278	    """The ATP outcome for one item (D-044): ``available`` = on_hand − committed + on_order;
279	    ``atp_ok`` is ``available >= requested``; ``shortfall`` is ``requested − available`` clamped at
280	    0. Informational — a shortfall flags a backorder, it does NOT block confirmation."""
281	
282	    item_id: uuid.UUID
283	    requested_quantity: Decimal
284	    on_hand: Decimal
285	    committed: Decimal
286	    on_order: Decimal
287	    available: Decimal
288	    atp_ok: bool
289	    shortfall: Decimal
290	
291	
292	async def atp_check(
293	    session: AsyncSession,
294	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
295	    *,
296	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
297	    quantity: Decimal,
298	    on_date: date,
299	    exclude_order_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
300	) -> AtpResult:
301	    """Available-to-promise for one item (PLAN 7.2, D-044): availability = inventory on-hand
302	    (``total_on_hand``) − committed (confirmed-undelivered sales orders) + on-order (procurement
303	    ``open_incoming_quantity``). ``on_date`` is accepted for the wire contract (v1 availability is
304	    a point-in-time snapshot — date-phased ATP is the documented later). Three bounded cross-module
305	    reads (inventory on-hand, sales committed, procurement on-order); no N+1. ``exclude_order_id``
306	    excludes one order from the committed sum (confirm checks an order net of OTHER commitments)."""
307	    requested = Decimal(str(quantity))
308	    on_hand = Decimal(str(await inventory_queries.total_on_hand(session, tenant_id, item_id)))
309	    committed = await committed_quantity(
310	        session, tenant_id, item_id, exclude_order_id=exclude_order_id
311	    )
312	    on_order = Decimal(
313	        str(await procurement_queries.open_incoming_quantity(session, tenant_id, item_id))
314	    )
315	    available = on_hand - committed + on_order
316	    shortfall = requested - available
317	    if shortfall < 0:
318	        shortfall = Decimal(0)
319	    return AtpResult(
320	        item_id=item_id,
321	        requested_quantity=requested,
322	        on_hand=on_hand,
323	        committed=committed,
324	        on_order=on_order,
325	        available=available,
326	        atp_ok=available >= requested,
327	        shortfall=shortfall,
328	    )
329	
330	
331	# --- Credit exposure (PLAN 7.2, D-044) --------------------------------------------------------
332	
333	
334	async def open_confirmed_order_value(
335	    session: AsyncSession,
336	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
337	    customer_id: uuid.UUID,
338	    *,
339	    exclude_order_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
340	) -> Decimal:
341	    """The total value of a customer's OPEN confirmed orders not yet billed (PLAN 7.2, D-044) — the
342	    open-order side of credit exposure. Sums ``total_amount`` over the customer's CONFIRMED /
343	    PARTIALLY_DELIVERED / DELIVERED orders (committed but not yet fully invoiced; an INVOICED
344	    order's
345	    exposure has moved to AR, a CLOSED/CANCELLED/DRAFT/CREDIT_BLOCKED order contributes nothing).
346	    ``exclude_order_id`` drops one order (the one being confirmed, counted separately).
347	
348	    SET-BASED (no per-order N+1): one filtered scan on the (tenant, customer_id, status) index,
349	    summed in Python so the exact-decimal MoneyType round-trips identically on both engines
350	    (D-015)."""
351	    stmt = select(SalesOrder.total_amount).where(
352	        SalesOrder.tenant_id == tenant_id,
353	        SalesOrder.customer_id == customer_id,
354	        SalesOrder.status.in_(
355	            [
356	                SalesOrderStatus.CONFIRMED.value,
357	                SalesOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_DELIVERED.value,
358	                SalesOrderStatus.DELIVERED.value,
359	            ]
360	        ),
361	    )
362	    if exclude_order_id is not None:
363	        stmt = stmt.where(SalesOrder.id != exclude_order_id)
364	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
365	    return sum((Decimal(str(value)) for (value,) in rows), Decimal(0))
366	
367	
368	async def customer_open_ar(
369	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, customer_id: uuid.UUID
370	) -> Decimal:
371	    """The customer's open AR (sum of open_amount on POSTED customer invoices) — the receivables
372	    side
373	    of credit exposure (PLAN 7.2, D-044). A thin alias over finance's ``customer_open_balance``
374	    keyed
375	    by the opaque partner_id (= Customer.id, D-029), named for the credit-check intent so the order
376	    flow reads it without importing finance models (the bottom-up cross-module read, STRUCTURE
377	    §5)."""
378	    return await finance_queries.customer_open_balance(session, tenant_id, customer_id)

1	"""Inventory's cross-module read interface (STRUCTURE §5).
2	
3	Inventory sits just above finance in the dependency order: every module above it (procurement,
4	sales, manufacturing) may import THIS file to read inventory state synchronously, and inventory
5	imports only finance/queries downward. Keep this surface thin and stable — it is a contract; it is
6	the ONLY inventory file other modules import.
7	
8	For PLAN 5.1 it exposes the item-master reads those modules will need: existence checks, the
9	item's base UoM and costing method, and the category's GL-account wiring (so the COGS handler can
10	resolve where to post when stock issues land in 5.2+). PLAN 5.2 adds the ON-HAND projection reads
11	(``total_on_hand``, ``on_hand_by_bin``, ``on_hand_by_lot``) — what sales ATP and procurement will
12	call: they read the MAINTAINED ``inv_stock_quants`` projection (D-036), an indexed aggregate, never
13	an unbounded SUM over the move history (PERFORMANCE §1).
14	
15	Every function takes an explicit ``tenant_id`` and runs under the caller's tenant context, so the
16	D-007 filter applies on top of the explicit predicate — ordinary tenant-scoped reads, not a bypass.
17	"""
18	
19	import uuid
20	from decimal import Decimal
21

23	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

62	    )

79	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
80	) -> tuple[uuid.UUID | None, uuid.UUID | None, uuid.UUID | None] | None:
81	    """The GL-account wiring (inventory, COGS, price-difference) of an item's category (D-020),
82	    or None if the item does not exist. The COGS handler (5.2+) resolves where to post a goods
83	    issue from this tuple. Any element may be None when the category has not wired that account
84	    yet — the issuing flow validates presence before it posts. One join, item -> category."""

100	) -> bool:

102	    target bin its stock lands in through this contract (D-029) rather than importing inventory
103	    models. Existence only — the move engine re-checks the bin is in an ACTIVE warehouse when it
104	    posts, so a receipt against an inactive-warehouse bin still fails (at post), loud."""

109	# --- On-hand projection reads (PLAN 5.2) --------------------------------------
110	# These read the MAINTAINED inv_stock_quants projection (D-036), kept in lock-step with the move
111	# ledger so on-hand is an indexed aggregate over a small current-state table, not a SUM over
112	# unbounded move history (PERFORMANCE §1). MoneyType/QuantityType propagation keeps the SUM exact on
113	# both engines (D-015); ``func.coalesce(..., 0)`` makes an item with no stock read 0, not None.

116	async def total_on_hand(
117	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
118	) -> Decimal:
119	    """Total on-hand quantity of an item across ALL bins and lots (PLAN 5.2). The number sales ATP
120	    starts from. Reads inv_stock_quants (the maintained projection), index-served by
121	    ``(tenant_id, item_id)``."""
122	    stmt = select(func.coalesce(func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty), 0)).where(
123	        StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id
124	    )
125	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one()
126	
127	
128	async def on_hand(
129	    session: AsyncSession,
130	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
131	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
132	    bin_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
133	    lot_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
134	) -> Decimal:
135	    """On-hand quantity of an item, optionally narrowed to one bin and/or one lot (PLAN 5.2). With
136	    no bin/lot this is ``total_on_hand``; with a bin it is that bin's stock; with a lot it is that
137	    lot's stock (in the bin if also given). Reads the maintained projection."""
138	    stmt = select(func.coalesce(func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty), 0)).where(
139	        StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id
140	    )
141	    if bin_id is not None:
142	        stmt = stmt.where(StockQuant.bin_id == bin_id)
143	    if lot_id is not None:
144	        stmt = stmt.where(StockQuant.lot_id == lot_id)
145	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one()
146	
147	
148	async def items_below_reorder_point(
149	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID
150	) -> list[tuple[uuid.UUID, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal]]:
151	    """Items whose total on-hand is AT OR BELOW their reorder point (PLAN 6.4, D-042) — the
152	    consumption-based replenishment scan. Returns ``(item_id, on_hand, reorder_point,
153	    reorder_quantity)`` for each ACTIVE item that carries a positive reorder point, has a positive
154	    reorder quantity, and whose on-hand (the maintained ``inv_stock_quants`` projection, summed per
155	    item) has fallen to or under that point. Procurement's reorder scan turns each into a draft
156	    requisition line for ``reorder_quantity``.
157	
158	    SET-BASED (no per-item N+1, PERFORMANCE §2): the on-hand sum is a LEFT JOIN + GROUP BY over the
159	    quant projection (items with no stock read 0 via coalesce), and the reorder predicate filters in
160	    SQL. Inventory OWNS reorder_point/reorder_quantity (5.1); the DRAFT requisition is a procurement
161	    document (6.2) — this query is the contract procurement reads, never importing inventory
162	    models."""
163	    on_hand_sum = func.coalesce(func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty), 0)
164	    stmt = (
165	        select(
166	            Item.id,
167	            on_hand_sum.label("on_hand"),
168	            Item.reorder_point,
169	            Item.reorder_quantity,
170	        )
171	        .join(
172	            StockQuant,
173	            (StockQuant.tenant_id == Item.tenant_id) & (StockQuant.item_id == Item.id),
174	            isouter=True,
175	        )
176	        .where(
177	            Item.tenant_id == tenant_id,
178	            Item.is_active.is_(True),
179	            Item.reorder_point.is_not(None),
180	            Item.reorder_point > 0,
181	            Item.reorder_quantity.is_not(None),
182	            Item.reorder_quantity > 0,
183	        )
184	        .group_by(Item.id, Item.reorder_point, Item.reorder_quantity)
185	        .having(on_hand_sum <= Item.reorder_point)
186	        .order_by(Item.item_code)
187	    )
188	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
189	    return [
190	        (row[0], Decimal(row[1]), Decimal(row[2]), Decimal(row[3]))
191	        for row in rows
192	    ]
193	
194	
195	async def on_hand_by_bin(
196	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
197	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
198	    """Per-bin on-hand totals for an item (PLAN 5.2): ``{bin_id: qty}`` summed across that bin's
199	    lots. Bins with zero net stock are absent (the move service deletes a quant when it hits 0, so
200	    the projection holds only live stock). What a bin-level stock-overview screen reads."""
201	    stmt = (
202	        select(StockQuant.bin_id, func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty))
203	        .where(StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id)
204	        .group_by(StockQuant.bin_id)
205	    )
206	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()

211	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
212	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
213	    """Per-lot on-hand totals for a LOT-tracked item (PLAN 5.2): ``{lot_id: qty}`` summed across
214	    bins. Quants with a NULL lot (fungible stock) are excluded — this view is for tracked items
215	    where lot traceability matters."""
216	    stmt = (
217	        select(StockQuant.lot_id, func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty))
218	        .where(
219	            StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id,
220	            StockQuant.item_id == item_id,
221	            StockQuant.lot_id.is_not(None),
222	        )
223	        .group_by(StockQuant.lot_id)
224	    )
225	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
226	    return {row[0]: row[1] for row in rows}

229	# --- Valuation reads (PLAN 5.3, D-020/D-037) ----------------------------------
230	# These read the VALUE SSOT (inv_item_valuations for moving-average, inv_cost_layers for FIFO), kept
231	# in lock-step with every move in the same transaction (D-037). The inventory-value dashboard KPI
232	# and
233	# valuation reports read these. MoneyType/QuantityType propagation keeps the SUMs exact (D-015).
234	
235	
236	async def item_value(
237	    session: AsyncSession,
238	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
239	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
240	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
241	) -> Decimal:
242	    """The current total inventory VALUE of an item (PLAN 5.3), optionally narrowed to one
243	    warehouse.
244	
245	    For a MOVING_AVERAGE item this sums ``inv_item_valuations.total_value``; for a FIFO item it sums
246	    ``remaining_qty × unit_cost`` over the live cost layers. An item uses exactly one method, so the
247	    other source contributes 0. The FIFO product is summed in PYTHON (each factor already a typed
248	    Decimal) rather than ``func.sum(qty × cost)``, because multiplying two scaled-integer columns on
249	    SQLite yields a ×10^12 value that the MoneyType result processor cannot un-scale (D-015 trigger
250	    discipline: SQL never multiplies two stored money/quantity columns)."""
251	    valuation_stmt = select(
252	        func.coalesce(func.sum(ItemValuation.total_value), 0)
253	    ).where(ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id, ItemValuation.item_id == item_id)
254	    layer_stmt = select(CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
255	        CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id,
256	        CostLayer.item_id == item_id,
257	        CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0,
258	    )
259	    if warehouse_id is not None:
260	        valuation_stmt = valuation_stmt.where(ItemValuation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
261	        layer_stmt = layer_stmt.where(CostLayer.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
262	    mav_value = Decimal((await session.execute(valuation_stmt)).scalar_one())
263	    fifo_value = sum(
264	        (Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost) for qty, cost in (await session.execute(layer_stmt)).all()),
265	        Decimal(0),
266	    )
267	    return mav_value + fifo_value
268	
269	
270	async def valuation_summary(
271	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID
272	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
273	    """Total inventory value per item across the tenant (PLAN 5.3): ``{item_id: value}`` — the
274	    moving-average totals plus the FIFO live-layer values, merged per item. What the inventory-value
275	    dashboard KPI sums. The moving-average totals are grouped in SQL; the FIFO layer products are
276	    summed in Python per item (D-015: no SQL multiply of two scaled money/quantity columns).
277	    PERFORMANCE §6: two reads, no per-item N+1."""
278	    mav_rows = (
279	        await session.execute(
280	            select(ItemValuation.item_id, func.sum(ItemValuation.total_value))
281	            .where(ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id)
282	            .group_by(ItemValuation.item_id)
283	        )
284	    ).all()
285	    layer_rows = (
286	        await session.execute(
287	            select(CostLayer.item_id, CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
288	                CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id, CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0
289	            )
290	        )
291	    ).all()
292	    totals: dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal] = {}
293	    for item_id_, value in mav_rows:
294	        if value is not None:
295	            totals[item_id_] = totals.get(item_id_, Decimal(0)) + Decimal(value)
296	    for item_id_, qty, cost in layer_rows:
297	        totals[item_id_] = totals.get(item_id_, Decimal(0)) + Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost)
298	    return totals
299	
300	
301	async def current_unit_cost(
302	    session: AsyncSession,
303	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
304	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
305	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
306	) -> Decimal:
307	    """The item's current per-unit BOOK cost in a warehouse (PLAN 5.4): the moving-average
308	    ``avg_unit_cost`` for a MOVING_AVERAGE item, or the weighted average of the live FIFO layers for
309	    a FIFO item — the SAME source a value-neutral transfer uses for its ledger cost
310	    (costing._current_unit_cost). A positive count variance enters stock at this cost so the value
311	    added matches the book cost (rather than an arbitrary entry price). Returns 0 when no
312	    valuation/layer exists yet (an item the system thinks is empty, counted positive — the
313	    adjustment then enters at 0 cost, a quantity-only correction with no value impact, which the
314	    operator can re-cost via a later receipt). The FIFO layer product is summed in PYTHON (D-015: no
315	    SQL multiply of two scaled money/quantity columns). One read for the MAV row, one for the FIFO
316	    layers (no per-layer N+1)."""
317	    valuation = (
318	        await session.execute(
319	            select(ItemValuation.avg_unit_cost).where(
320	                ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id,
321	                ItemValuation.item_id == item_id,
322	                ItemValuation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
323	            )
324	        )
325	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
326	    if valuation is not None:
327	        return Decimal(valuation)
328	    rows = (
329	        await session.execute(
330	            select(CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
331	                CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id,
332	                CostLayer.item_id == item_id,
333	                CostLayer.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
334	                CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0,
335	            )
336	        )
337	    ).all()
338	    total_qty = sum((Decimal(qty) for qty, _cost in rows), Decimal(0))
339	    total_value = sum((Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost) for qty, cost in rows), Decimal(0))
340	    return (total_value / total_qty) if total_qty > 0 else Decimal(0)

1	"""Sales-order business logic (PLAN 7.2): create from scratch, update, cancel + reads, plus the
2	shared line/total writer both the from-scratch and convert paths use.
3	
4	Lifecycle (constants.SalesOrderStatus) — states SET in 7.2: DRAFT → (confirm) CONFIRMED or
5	CREDIT_BLOCKED, plus CANCELLED. PARTIALLY_DELIVERED / DELIVERED / INVOICED / CLOSED are driven by
6	7.3/7.4 (declared in constants, transitions land later). The confirm gate (ATP + credit) lives in
7	``order_confirm.py``; the quote→order conversion lives in ``conversions.py``; the shared writer +
8	the document reads live here so both paths produce identical order rows.
9	
10	Source-control rule at create: the customer must be ACTIVE (not BLOCKED/INACTIVE → 422
11	sales.customer_not_active — the soft block, distinct from the credit-limit block). ``line_amount`` =
12	qty × unit_price − discount; ``total_amount`` = Σ line_amount; ``payment_terms_days`` is snapshot
13	from the customer at create. The SO number is claimed AT CREATION (D-012/D-040). An order starts
14	DRAFT; confirmation is the gate.
15	"""
16	
17	from __future__ import annotations
18	
19	import uuid
20	from datetime import date
21	from decimal import Decimal
22	
23	from sqlalchemy import select
24	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
25	
26	from app.core import docflow
27	from app.core.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
28	from app.core.pagination import (
29	    DEFAULT_LIMIT,
30	    OrderKey,
31	    SortDirection,
32	    filter_fingerprint,
33	    paginate,
34	)
35	from app.core.schemas import Page
36	from app.modules.sales import queries as sales_queries
37	from app.modules.sales.constants import (
38	    SALES_ORDER_DOC_TYPE,
39	    SALES_ORDER_NUMBER_PADDING,
40	    SALES_ORDER_NUMBER_PREFIX,
41	    SALES_ORDER_SEQUENCE_NAME,
42	    SalesOrderStatus,
43	)
44	from app.modules.sales.models import SalesOrder, SalesOrderLine
45	from app.modules.sales.schemas import SalesOrderCreate, SalesOrderUpdate
46	from app.modules.sales.service._shared import (
47	    LineInput,
48	    build_line_input,
49	    claim_document_number,
50	    require_active_customer,
51	    resolve_currency,
52	    validate_quantity,
53	)
54	
55	
56	async def get_sales_order(
57	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, order_id: uuid.UUID
58	) -> SalesOrder:
59	    order = await session.get(SalesOrder, order_id)
60	    if order is None or order.tenant_id != tenant_id:
61	        raise NotFoundError(message="Sales order not found", code="sales.order_not_found")
62	    return order
63	
64	
65	async def get_sales_order_lines(
66	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, order_id: uuid.UUID
67	) -> list[SalesOrderLine]:
68	    stmt = (
69	        select(SalesOrderLine)
70	        .where(SalesOrderLine.tenant_id == tenant_id, SalesOrderLine.order_id == order_id)
71	        .order_by(SalesOrderLine.line_number)
72	    )
73	    return list((await session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
74	
75	
76	async def _build_lines(
77	    session: AsyncSession,
78	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
79	    *,
80	    customer_id: uuid.UUID,
81	    currency_code: str,
82	    on_date: date,
83	    payload_lines: list,
84	) -> list[LineInput]:
85	    if not payload_lines:
86	        raise ValidationFailedError(
87	            message="A sales order needs at least one line", code="sales.order_no_lines"
88	        )
89	    return [
90	        await build_line_input(
91	            session,
92	            tenant_id,
93	            customer_id=customer_id,
94	            currency_code=currency_code,
95	            on_date=on_date,
96	            item_id=line.item_id,
97	            description=line.description,
98	            quantity=Decimal(str(line.quantity)),
99	            uom_id=line.uom_id,
100	            unit_price=line.unit_price,
101	            discount_type=line.discount_type,
102	            discount_value=line.discount_value,
103	            tax_code_id=getattr(line, "tax_code_id", None),
104	        )
105	        for line in payload_lines
106	    ]
107	
108	
109	def _write_lines(
110	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, order_id: uuid.UUID, lines: list[LineInput]
111	) -> Decimal:
112	    total = Decimal(0)
113	    for index, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
114	        total += line.line_amount
115	        session.add(
116	            SalesOrderLine(
117	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
118	                order_id=order_id,
119	                line_number=index,
120	                item_id=line.item_id,
121	                description=line.description,
122	                ordered_quantity=line.quantity,
123	                uom_id=line.uom_id,
124	                unit_price=line.unit_price,
125	                discount_type=line.discount_type,
126	                discount_value=line.discount_value,
127	                line_amount=line.line_amount,
128	                delivered_quantity=Decimal(0),
129	                invoiced_quantity=Decimal(0),
130	                tax_code_id=line.tax_code_id,
131	            )
132	        )
133	    return total
134	
135	
136	async def write_sales_order(
137	    session: AsyncSession,
138	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
139	    *,
140	    customer_id: uuid.UUID,
141	    currency_code: str,
142	    order_date: date,
143	    requested_date: date | None,
144	    notes: str | None,
145	    lines: list[LineInput],
146	    source_quote_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
147	) -> SalesOrder:
148	    """Write a DRAFT order header + lines (the shared writer for from-scratch + convert paths).
149	    Snapshots the customer's payment-terms, claims the SO number + registers the document AT
150	    CREATION
151	    (D-012/D-040), and computes ``total_amount``. The caller has already validated the customer is
152	    ACTIVE and resolved/priced the lines."""
153	    if not lines:
154	        raise ValidationFailedError(
155	            message="A sales order needs at least one line", code="sales.order_no_lines"
156	        )
157	    terms = await sales_queries.customer_payment_terms_days(session, tenant_id, customer_id)
158	
159	    order_id = uuid.uuid4()
160	    document = await docflow.register_document(
161	        session,
162	        tenant_id,
163	        SALES_ORDER_DOC_TYPE,
164	        order_id,
165	        doc_number=None,
166	        status=SalesOrderStatus.DRAFT.value,
167	    )
168	    number = await claim_document_number(
169	        session,
170	        tenant_id,
171	        sequence_name=SALES_ORDER_SEQUENCE_NAME,
172	        prefix=SALES_ORDER_NUMBER_PREFIX,
173	        padding=SALES_ORDER_NUMBER_PADDING,
174	        on_date=order_date,
175	    )
176	    order = SalesOrder(
177	        id=order_id,
178	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
179	        document_id=document.id,
180	        order_number=number,
181	        status=SalesOrderStatus.DRAFT.value,
182	        customer_id=customer_id,
183	        currency_code=currency_code,
184	        order_date=order_date,
185	        requested_date=requested_date,
186	        payment_terms_days=terms or 0,
187	        total_amount=Decimal(0),
188	        source_quote_id=source_quote_id,
189	        credit_check_status=None,
190	        notes=notes,
191	    )
192	    session.add(order)
193	    order.total_amount = _write_lines(session, tenant_id, order_id, lines)
194	    await session.flush()
195	    await docflow.set_document_status(
196	        session, tenant_id, document.id, doc_number=number, status=SalesOrderStatus.DRAFT.value
197	    )
198	    return order
199	
200	
201	async def create_sales_order(
202	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, payload: SalesOrderCreate
203	) -> SalesOrder:
204	    """Create a DRAFT order from scratch (PLAN 7.2). Validates the customer is ACTIVE, resolves the
205	    currency (supplied or the customer's default), prices each line (resolver default + discount),
206	    then writes the document via the shared writer."""
207	    await require_active_customer(session, tenant_id, payload.customer_id)
208	    order_date = payload.order_date or date.today()
209	    currency = await resolve_currency(
210	        session, tenant_id, payload.customer_id, payload.currency_code
211	    )
212	    lines = await _build_lines(
213	        session,
214	        tenant_id,
215	        customer_id=payload.customer_id,
216	        currency_code=currency,
217	        on_date=order_date,
218	        payload_lines=payload.lines,
219	    )
220	    return await write_sales_order(
221	        session,
222	        tenant_id,
223	        customer_id=payload.customer_id,
224	        currency_code=currency,
225	        order_date=order_date,
226	        requested_date=payload.requested_date,
227	        notes=payload.notes,
228	        lines=lines,
229	    )
230	
231	
232	async def update_sales_order(
233	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, order_id: uuid.UUID, payload: SalesOrderUpdate
234	) -> SalesOrder:
235	    """Partial header update of a DRAFT order (PLAN 7.2). When ``lines`` is supplied they are
236	    replaced wholesale (revalidated + repriced + the total recomputed). Only a DRAFT order is
237	    editable — a CONFIRMED order is a firm commitment."""
238	    order = await get_sales_order(session, tenant_id, order_id)
239	    if SalesOrderStatus(order.status) != SalesOrderStatus.DRAFT:
240	        raise ConflictError(
241	            message="Only a draft sales order can be edited",
242	            code="sales.order_not_draft",
243	            details={"status": order.status},
244	        )
245	    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
246	    new_lines = data.pop("lines", None)
247	    if "currency_code" in data and data["currency_code"] is not None:
248	        order.currency_code = await resolve_currency(
249	            session, tenant_id, order.customer_id, data.pop("currency_code")
250	        )
251	    else:
252	        data.pop("currency_code", None)
253	    for field, value in data.items():
254	        setattr(order, field, value)
255	    if new_lines is not None:
256	        lines = await _build_lines(
257	            session,
258	            tenant_id,
259	            customer_id=order.customer_id,
260	            currency_code=order.currency_code,
261	            on_date=order.order_date,
262	            payload_lines=payload.lines,
263	        )
264	        for existing in await get_sales_order_lines(session, tenant_id, order_id):
265	            await session.delete(existing)
266	        await session.flush()
267	        order.total_amount = _write_lines(session, tenant_id, order_id, lines)
268	    await session.flush()
269	    return order
270	
271	
272	async def cancel_sales_order(
273	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, order_id: uuid.UUID
274	) -> SalesOrder:
275	    """Cancel an order (PLAN 7.2). Forbidden once any delivery (7.3) or invoice (7.4) exists, or if
276	    already terminal — a delivered/invoiced order is corrected downstream, never cancelled. A DRAFT,
277	    CONFIRMED or CREDIT_BLOCKED order with no fulfilment can be cancelled."""
278	    order = await get_sales_order(session, tenant_id, order_id)
279	    status = SalesOrderStatus(order.status)
280	    if status in (
281	        SalesOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_DELIVERED,
282	        SalesOrderStatus.DELIVERED,
283	        SalesOrderStatus.INVOICED,
284	        SalesOrderStatus.CLOSED,
285	        SalesOrderStatus.CANCELLED,
286	    ):
287	        raise ConflictError(
288	            message=f"A {order.status} sales order cannot be cancelled",
289	            code="sales.order_not_cancellable",
290	            details={"status": order.status},
291	        )
292	    # Defence in depth: even for a CONFIRMED order with no status advance yet, refuse if a line has
293	    # been (partially) delivered or invoiced (7.3/7.4 raise the line columns).
294	    for line in await get_sales_order_lines(session, tenant_id, order_id):
295	        if Decimal(str(line.delivered_quantity)) > 0 or Decimal(str(line.invoiced_quantity)) > 0:
296	            raise ConflictError(
297	                message="A sales order with delivered or invoiced lines cannot be cancelled",
298	                code="sales.order_not_cancellable",
299	                details={"order_id": str(order_id)},
300	            )
301	    order.status = SalesOrderStatus.CANCELLED.value
302	    await session.flush()
303	    await docflow.set_document_status(
304	        session, tenant_id, order.document_id, status=SalesOrderStatus.CANCELLED.value
305	    )
306	    return order
307	
308	
309	def validate_line_quantity(quantity: Decimal) -> Decimal:
310	    """Re-exported for the conversion path (a quote line's quantity is revalidated > 0)."""
311	    return validate_quantity(quantity)
312	
313	
314	async def list_sales_orders(
315	    session: AsyncSession,
316	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
317	    *,
318	    status: SalesOrderStatus | None = None,
319	    customer_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
320	    cursor: str | None = None,
321	    limit: int = DEFAULT_LIMIT,
322	) -> Page[SalesOrder]:
323	    """Keyset-paginated order list, newest first (D-014). status + customer filters fold into the
324	    cursor fingerprint; the (tenant, status) / (tenant, customer_id, status) indexes serve the
325	    filtered page (PERFORMANCE §1)."""
326	    stmt = select(SalesOrder).where(SalesOrder.tenant_id == tenant_id)
327	    if status is not None:
328	        stmt = stmt.where(SalesOrder.status == SalesOrderStatus(status).value)
329	    if customer_id is not None:
330	        stmt = stmt.where(SalesOrder.customer_id == customer_id)
331	    return await paginate(
332	        session,
333	        stmt,
334	        order_by=[OrderKey(SalesOrder.created_at, SortDirection.DESC)],
335	        pk=SalesOrder.id,
336	        cursor=cursor,
337	        limit=limit,
338	        filters=filter_fingerprint(status, customer_id),
339	    )

1	"""Shared validation + numbering + line-pricing helpers for the O2C document services (PLAN 7.2).
2	
3	Kept in one private module so the quote / order / conversion services stay small and the
4	cross-module validation rules (item exists, currency exists, customer exists/ACTIVE) + the line
5	pricing math (resolver default, discount, line amount) live in ONE place — greppable and consistent.
6	Every cross-module check goes through the owning module's queries contract (D-029), never a
7	cross-module FK. The numbering helper wraps ensure_sequence + claim_number so both documents claim
8	their gapless number at creation identically (D-012/D-040).
9	"""
10	
11	from __future__ import annotations
12	
13	import uuid
14	from dataclasses import dataclass
15	from datetime import date
16	from decimal import Decimal
17	
18	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
19	
20	from app.core.exceptions import ValidationFailedError
21	from app.core.money import quantize_for_currency
22	from app.core.numbering import claim_number, ensure_sequence
23	from app.modules.finance import queries as finance_queries
24	from app.modules.inventory import queries as inventory_queries
25	from app.modules.sales import queries as sales_queries
26	from app.modules.sales.constants import CustomerStatus, DiscountType
27	
28	
29	@dataclass(frozen=True)
30	class LineInput:
31	    """The validated, currency-resolved input for one quote/order line — produced by the create /
32	    convert paths and consumed by the document writers. ``unit_price`` is already resolved (the
33	    payload value or the price-resolver default); ``line_amount`` is the computed net."""
34	
35	    item_id: uuid.UUID
36	    description: str | None
37	    quantity: Decimal
38	    uom_id: uuid.UUID
39	    unit_price: Decimal
40	    discount_type: str | None
41	    discount_value: Decimal | None
42	    line_amount: Decimal
43	    tax_code_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
44	
45	
46	async def validate_currency(
47	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, currency_code: str
48	) -> None:
49	    """The currency must exist in finance's catalog (D-029, via finance/queries)."""
50	    if not await finance_queries.currency_exists(session, tenant_id, currency_code):
51	        raise ValidationFailedError(
52	            message=f"Currency {currency_code} does not exist in the finance catalog",
53	            code="sales.currency_not_found",
54	            details={"currency_code": currency_code},
55	        )
56	
57	
58	async def validate_item(
59	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
60	) -> None:
61	    """The item must exist in inventory (D-029, via inventory/queries.item_exists)."""
62	    if not await inventory_queries.item_exists(session, tenant_id, item_id):
63	        raise ValidationFailedError(
64	            message="Referenced inventory item does not exist",
65	            code="sales.item_not_found",
66	            details={"item_id": str(item_id)},
67	        )
68	
69	
70	def validate_quantity(quantity: Decimal) -> Decimal:
71	    """A document line quantity must be > 0 (every quote/order line)."""
72	    qty = Decimal(str(quantity))
73	    if qty <= 0:
74	        raise ValidationFailedError(
75	            message="A line quantity must be greater than zero",
76	            code="sales.line_quantity_invalid",
77	            details={"quantity": str(qty)},
78	        )
79	    return qty
80	
81	
82	async def require_customer_exists(
83	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, customer_id: uuid.UUID
84	) -> None:
85	    """The customer must exist (a quote may name any existing customer — the ACTIVE gate is an
86	    ORDER-confirmation rule, not a quote rule). Reads via sales/queries (intra-module)."""
87	    if not await sales_queries.customer_exists(session, tenant_id, customer_id):
88	        raise ValidationFailedError(
89	            message="Referenced customer does not exist",
90	            code="sales.customer_not_found",
91	            details={"customer_id": str(customer_id)},
92	        )
93	
94	
95	async def require_active_customer(
96	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, customer_id: uuid.UUID
97	) -> None:
98	    """The customer must exist AND be ACTIVE (not BLOCKED/INACTIVE) — the v1 order source-control
99	    rule (the soft block, distinct from the credit-limit block). Reads the status via sales/queries.
100	    Raises 422 sales.customer_not_active otherwise."""
101	    status = await sales_queries.customer_status(session, tenant_id, customer_id)
102	    if status is None:
103	        raise ValidationFailedError(
104	            message="Referenced customer does not exist",
105	            code="sales.customer_not_found",
106	            details={"customer_id": str(customer_id)},
107	        )
108	    if status != CustomerStatus.ACTIVE:
109	        raise ValidationFailedError(
110	            message=f"Customer is {status.value}; a sales order needs an ACTIVE customer",
111	            code="sales.customer_not_active",
112	            details={"customer_id": str(customer_id), "status": status.value},
113	        )
114	
115	
116	async def resolve_currency(
117	    session: AsyncSession,
118	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
119	    customer_id: uuid.UUID,
120	    currency_code: str | None,
121	) -> str:
122	    """Resolve a document's currency: the supplied code, else the customer's default currency. The
123	    result is validated to exist in finance (a customer's default is already validated at customer
124	    create, but a supplied override must be re-checked)."""
125	    resolved = currency_code or await sales_queries.customer_default_currency(
126	        session, tenant_id, customer_id
127	    )
128	    if resolved is None:
129	        raise ValidationFailedError(
130	            message="The customer has no default currency and none was supplied",
131	            code="sales.currency_unresolved",
132	            details={"customer_id": str(customer_id)},
133	        )
134	    await validate_currency(session, tenant_id, resolved)
135	    return resolved
136	
137	
138	def compute_line_amount(
139	    quantity: Decimal,
140	    unit_price: Decimal,
141	    discount_type: str | None,
142	    discount_value: Decimal | None,
143	    currency_code: str,
144	) -> Decimal:
145	    """The net line amount = qty × unit_price − discount, quantized to the currency (D-015). A
146	    PERCENT discount takes ``discount_value`` % off the gross (qty × unit_price); an AMOUNT discount
147	    takes ``discount_value`` off per unit (× qty). The result is clamped at 0 (a discount can zero a
148	    line but never make it negative)."""
149	    gross = Decimal(str(quantity)) * Decimal(str(unit_price))
150	    discount = Decimal(0)
151	    if discount_type is not None and discount_value is not None:
152	        value = Decimal(str(discount_value))
153	        if DiscountType(discount_type) == DiscountType.PERCENT:
154	            discount = gross * value / Decimal(100)
155	        else:  # AMOUNT: per-unit amount off
156	            discount = value * Decimal(str(quantity))
157	    net = gross - discount
158	    if net < 0:
159	        net = Decimal(0)
160	    return quantize_for_currency(net, currency_code)
161	
162	
163	async def build_line_input(
164	    session: AsyncSession,
165	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
166	    *,
167	    customer_id: uuid.UUID,
168	    currency_code: str,
169	    on_date: date,
170	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
171	    description: str | None,
172	    quantity: Decimal,
173	    uom_id: uuid.UUID,
174	    unit_price: Decimal | None,
175	    discount_type: str | None,
176	    discount_value: Decimal | None,
177	    tax_code_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
178	) -> LineInput:
179	    """Validate one line + resolve its price into a :class:`LineInput`. The item is validated to
180	    exist; the quantity to be > 0. When ``unit_price`` is None the price resolver (D-043) defaults
181	    it
182	    for this item/customer/date/quantity/currency — and a no-match resolution with no supplied price
183	    is rejected (the line needs a price). The discount is applied to compute the net line amount."""
184	    await validate_item(session, tenant_id, item_id)
185	    qty = validate_quantity(quantity)
186	    resolved_price = unit_price
187	    if resolved_price is None:
188	        resolved = await sales_queries.resolve_price(
189	            session,
190	            tenant_id,
191	            item_id=item_id,
192	            customer_id=customer_id,
193	            on_date=on_date,
194	            quantity=qty,
195	            currency=currency_code,
196	        )
197	        if not resolved.matched or resolved.unit_price is None:
198	            raise ValidationFailedError(
199	                message="No price list applies to this item; supply a unit price",
200	                code="sales.price_unresolved",
201	                details={"item_id": str(item_id)},
202	            )
203	        resolved_price = resolved.unit_price
204	    price = Decimal(str(resolved_price))
205	    if price < 0:
206	        raise ValidationFailedError(
207	            message="A line unit price cannot be negative",
208	            code="sales.unit_price_invalid",
209	            details={"item_id": str(item_id)},
210	        )
211	    dtype = discount_type if discount_type is not None else None
212	    dvalue = (
213	        Decimal(str(discount_value))
214	        if discount_type is not None and discount_value is not None
215	        else None
216	    )
217	    line_amount = compute_line_amount(qty, price, dtype, dvalue, currency_code)
218	    return LineInput(
219	        item_id=item_id,
220	        description=description,
221	        quantity=qty,
222	        uom_id=uom_id,
223	        unit_price=price,
224	        discount_type=dtype,
225	        discount_value=dvalue,
226	        line_amount=line_amount,
227	        tax_code_id=tax_code_id,
228	    )
229	
230	
231	async def claim_document_number(
232	    session: AsyncSession,
233	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
234	    *,
235	    sequence_name: str,
236	    prefix: str,
237	    padding: int,
238	    on_date: date,

1	"""Sales-order HTTP layer (PLAN 7.2), included into the sales router.
2	
3	A sibling router under the same ``/api/v1/sales`` prefix, mounted by ``router.include_router`` in
4	router.py (the procurement po_router precedent — ONE module surface, no second mount in main.py).
5	
6	RBAC (D-009; distinct authorities):
7	  - read by ``sales.order.read``;
8	  - create/edit/convert/cancel by ``sales.order.manage``;
9	  - confirm (the ATP + credit gate) by the distinct ``sales.order.confirm``;
10	  - credit-release (override a credit block) by the distinct ``sales.order.credit_release``.
11	
12	Writes commit through ``run_in_uow`` (D-011); the document-creating + convert + confirm + release
13	endpoints are IDEMPOTENT (D-013). The confirm/release endpoints return the order detail — a
14	CREDIT_BLOCKED order comes back with status CREDIT_BLOCKED + credit_check_status BLOCKED rather than
15	an error (the block is a business outcome, not a failure); a backordered confirm still succeeds
16	(CONFIRMED) — the ATP snapshot is informational. The ATP-check endpoint is a READ surface over the
17	availability query for the order-entry UI.

1	"""Sales test data builders behind tests/modules/sales/conftest.py (STRUCTURE §6/§8.4).
2	
3	Builders go through the REAL service layer under the tenant context (D-025), so tenancy stamping and
4	audit fire exactly as in production. conftest.py keeps only the thin pytest fixtures.
5	
6	``build_sales_setup`` wires a tenant ready to create customers + price lists: it seeds a currency
7	(USD) in finance — the cross-module read ``default_currency_code`` / a price list's
8	``currency_code``
9	validate against — and an inventory item (so price-list-item validation has a real item to point
10	at).
11	``create_sales_principal`` mirrors the finance/inventory/procurement principal pattern with sales.*
12	keys (and supports a narrowed ``keys`` grant for the 403 RBAC tests), plus the finance + inventory
13	setup keys the cross-module-aware API tests need.
14	"""
15	
16	import uuid
17	from dataclasses import dataclass
18	from datetime import date

212	    numbering + docflow fire as in production. ``line_kwargs`` overrides the line (discount_type,
213	    discount_value, ...)."""
214	    holder: dict[str, uuid.UUID] = {}
215	    line_fields: dict[str, object] = {

218	        "uom_id": uom_id,

220	    }
221	    line_fields.update(line_kwargs)

223	    async def work() -> None:
224	        with tenant_context(tenant_id):
225	            quote = await service.create_quote(
226	                session,
227	                tenant_id,

"""Domain events sales PUBLISHES (D-011/D-041). Declarative data only — no logic, no models — so
inventory's ``handlers.py`` may import these typed classes (the STRUCTURE §5 events.py allowance: an
event carries no behaviour, so a subscriber in another module imports it without any logic).

``DeliveryShipped`` is the SANCTIONED cross-module mechanism for the delivery → stock-issue effect
(D-045), the OUTBOUND TWIN of procurement's ``GoodsReceiptPosted`` (D-041, mirrored). Sales OWNS the
delivery document and its sales order; it MUST NOT call inventory's service directly (STRUCTURE §5
forbids importing another module's service). So the delivery POST publishes this event carrying
everything inventory needs to create the stock ISSUE moves — one ``DeliveryMove`` per delivery line
(item, the SOURCE bin to issue from, quantity, lot/serial) plus the move_date and the delivery's
core_documents id for docflow linkage. Inventory's ``handlers.py`` subscribes, creates each move via
its OWN service with ``move_type=ISSUE``, and links delivery document → 'moved_by' → move document.
The handler shares the session, so the moves + their COGS/inventory journals land in the SAME
transaction as the delivery post — all-or-nothing (D-011/D-020): a closed period or any handler
failure (e.g. insufficient stock) rolls the WHOLE delivery post back.

The KEY DIFFERENCE from ``GoodsReceiptPosted`` (D-045): the event carries NO GL accounts. A receipt
overrode its valuation offset to the GR/IR clearing account (a three-way-match leg), so that event
carried ``gr_ir_account_id``. An ISSUE move's DEFAULT valuation offset IS the item category's COGS
account (resolved inside the costing engine from the item's category), so a delivery needs no offset
override — COGS *is* the issue offset — and the event carries no account at all.

Sales updates its OWN tables (the order-line delivered_quantity, the order status, the delivery
status/posted_at) in that same transaction AFTER publishing; it does NOT need the move ids back — the
delivery↔move link is the durable docflow edge the handler writes, not a cross-module FK column
(D-041/D-045).
"""

import uuid
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import ClassVar

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

from app.core.events import DomainEvent
from app.modules.sales.constants import DELIVERY_SHIPPED_EVENT_KEY


class DeliveryMove(BaseModel):
    """One delivery line's worth of stock to issue (D-045), the payload inventory's handler turns
    into a stock ISSUE move. Plain frozen data: the opaque item + SOURCE bin ids (D-029), the
    quantity issued in the item's base UoM, and optional lot/serial codes (the lot/serial the stock
    leaves on for tracked items). No unit cost — the costing engine COMPUTES the COGS of the stock
    that left (FIFO layers / moving-average), unlike a receipt which enters at a supplied cost."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)

    item_id: uuid.UUID
    bin_id: uuid.UUID
    quantity: Decimal
    lot_code: str | None = None
    serial_code: str | None = None


class DeliveryShipped(DomainEvent):
    """A delivery was posted / shipped (D-045). Inventory's ``handlers.py`` subscribes and creates one
    stock ISSUE move per ``move`` in the SAME transaction, each offsetting to the item-category COGS
    account by DEFAULT (Dr COGS / Cr Inventory — no offset override, unlike the GR/IR receipt), and
    links the delivery document to each move document ('moved_by').

    - ``delivery_id`` + ``delivery_number`` + ``document_id`` — the delivery document (``document_id``
      is the core_documents id the handler links the move documents to).
    - ``warehouse_id`` — the inventory warehouse the shipment's stock issues from (each move's bin is

    - ``move_date`` — the delivery date the stock moves post on (ISO date string); a date in a CLOSED
      period makes each move's COGS journal trip the period trigger, rolling the whole delivery back.
    - ``moves`` — the per-line issues (see ``DeliveryMove``)."""

    key: ClassVar[str] = DELIVERY_SHIPPED_EVENT_KEY

    delivery_id: uuid.UUID
    delivery_number: str
    document_id: uuid.UUID
    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID
    move_date: str
    moves: tuple[DeliveryMove, ...]

Keyset-paginated list (filter by order / status / delivery-date range) + header/line point reads.

(D-014). Mirrors goods_receipt_reads.py (the outbound twin).

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import select

async def get_delivery(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, delivery_id: uuid.UUID
) -> Delivery:
    delivery = await session.get(Delivery, delivery_id)
    if delivery is None or delivery.tenant_id != tenant_id:
        raise NotFoundError(message="Delivery not found", code="sales.delivery_not_found")
    return delivery


async def get_delivery_lines(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, delivery_id: uuid.UUID
) -> list[DeliveryLine]:
    stmt = (
        select(DeliveryLine)
        .where(DeliveryLine.tenant_id == tenant_id, DeliveryLine.delivery_id == delivery_id)
        .order_by(DeliveryLine.line_number)
    )
    return list((await session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())


async def list_deliveries(
    session: AsyncSession,
    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    sales_order_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    status: DeliveryStatus | None = None,
    date_from: date | None = None,
    date_to: date | None = None,
    cursor: str | None = None,
    limit: int = DEFAULT_LIMIT,
) -> Page[Delivery]:
    """Keyset-paginated delivery list, newest first (D-014). The order / status / date filters fold
    into the cursor fingerprint; the (tenant, status) and (tenant, sales_order_id) indexes serve the
    filtered page (PERFORMANCE §1)."""
    stmt = select(Delivery).where(Delivery.tenant_id == tenant_id)
    if sales_order_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Delivery.sales_order_id == sales_order_id)
    if status is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Delivery.status == DeliveryStatus(status).value)
    if date_from is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Delivery.delivery_date >= date_from)
    if date_to is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Delivery.delivery_date <= date_to)
    return await paginate(
        session,
        stmt,
        order_by=[OrderKey(Delivery.created_at, SortDirection.DESC)],
        pk=Delivery.id,
        cursor=cursor,
        limit=limit,
        filters=filter_fingerprint(sales_order_id, status, date_from, date_to),
    )


async def deliveries_for_order(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, order_id: uuid.UUID
) -> list[Delivery]:

        .order_by(Delivery.created_at.desc())
    )
    return list((await session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())

DELIVERED), links docflow order→delivery, and sets the delivery POSTED. A closed delivery period trips
a move's journal trigger and rolls the WHOLE post back.

Cross-module rule (STRUCTURE §5 / D-045): sales NEVER calls inventory's service — the stock effect
goes through the event bus. Sales reads bins / on-hand via inventory/queries (downward reads), updates

/ Cr Inventory with no account on the event — COGS *is* the issue offset (D-045/D-020).

import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core import docflow
from app.core.events import publish
from app.core.exceptions import ConflictError, ValidationFailedError
from app.modules.inventory import queries as inventory_queries
from app.modules.sales.constants import (
    DELIVERY_DOC_TYPE,
    DELIVERY_NUMBER_PADDING,
    DELIVERY_NUMBER_PREFIX,
    DELIVERY_SEQUENCE_NAME,
    ORDER_DELIVERED_BY_DELIVERY_LINK,
    DeliveryStatus,
    SalesOrderStatus,
)

from app.modules.sales.schemas import DeliveryCreate
from app.modules.sales.service._shared import claim_document_number

# A sales order is deliverable once CONFIRMED, or while partially delivered (a follow-up delivery
# completes a backorder). DRAFT / CREDIT_BLOCKED / CANCELLED / fully-DELIVERED / INVOICED / CLOSED
# cannot start a NEW delivery (D-044: only a firm commitment with open undelivered lines ships).
_DELIVERABLE_ORDER_STATUSES = frozenset(
    {
        SalesOrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
        SalesOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_DELIVERED,
    }
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _DeliveryLineInput:
    """One validated delivery line: the order line it ships against, the snapshot item from that
    line, the SOURCE bin, the shipped quantity, and optional lot/serial."""

    sales_order_line_id: uuid.UUID

async def _require_deliverable_order(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, order_id: uuid.UUID

        raise ValidationFailedError(
            message="Referenced sales order does not exist",
            code="sales.order_not_found",
            details={"sales_order_id": str(order_id)},

    if SalesOrderStatus(order.status) not in _DELIVERABLE_ORDER_STATUSES:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            message=f"A {order.status} sales order cannot ship a delivery",
            code="sales.order_not_confirmed",
            details={"sales_order_id": str(order_id), "status": order.status},

    session: AsyncSession,
    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
    order_id: uuid.UUID,
    order_lines: dict[uuid.UUID, SalesOrderLine],
    payload_line: object,

    is > 0 and within the still-open-to-deliver quantity (over-delivery REJECTED 422 in v1), the

            message="The delivery line does not belong to this sales order",
            code="sales.delivery_line_not_on_order",

                ),

        str(order_line.delivered_quantity)

            message="The shipped quantity exceeds the order line's open-to-deliver quantity",

        raise ValidationFailedError(
            message="The source bin does not exist in inventory",
            code="sales.delivery_bin_not_found",
            details={"bin_id": str(bin_id)},

            details={
                "bin_id": str(bin_id),
                "item_id": str(order_line.item_id),
                "on_hand": str(available),
                "quantity": str(qty),
            },
        )
    return _DeliveryLineInput(
        sales_order_line_id=order_line.id,
        item_id=order_line.item_id,
        bin_id=bin_id,
        quantity=qty,
        lot_code=payload_line.lot_code,  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        serial_code=payload_line.serial_code,  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    )


def _validate_quantity(quantity: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    qty = Decimal(str(quantity))
    if qty <= 0:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            message="A delivery line quantity must be greater than zero",
            code="sales.line_quantity_invalid",
            details={"quantity": str(qty)},
        )
    return qty


async def create_delivery(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, payload: DeliveryCreate
) -> Delivery:
    """Create a DRAFT delivery against a sales order (PLAN 7.3). Validates the order is deliverable
    (CONFIRMED / PARTIALLY_DELIVERED → else 422 sales.order_not_confirmed), each line belongs to it,
    the quantity is within the open-to-deliver quantity (over-delivery → 422 sales.over_delivery),
    the source bin exists, and that bin holds enough stock (422 sales.insufficient_stock). Snapshots
    the customer from the order + per-line item from the order line and claims the DN number at
    creation (D-040). No stock moves yet — that is POST."""
    if not payload.lines:
        raise ValidationFailedError(
            message="A delivery needs at least one line",
            code="sales.delivery_no_lines",
        )
    order = await _require_deliverable_order(session, tenant_id, payload.sales_order_id)
    order_lines = {line.id: line for line in await get_sales_order_lines(session, tenant_id, order.id)}
    delivery_date = payload.delivery_date or date.today()

    validated = [
        await _validate_delivery_line(session, tenant_id, order.id, order_lines, line)
        for line in payload.lines
    ]

    delivery_id = uuid.uuid4()
    document = await docflow.register_document(
        session,
        tenant_id,
        DELIVERY_DOC_TYPE,
        delivery_id,
        doc_number=None,
        status=DeliveryStatus.DRAFT.value,
    )
    number = await claim_document_number(
        session,
        tenant_id,
        sequence_name=DELIVERY_SEQUENCE_NAME,
        prefix=DELIVERY_NUMBER_PREFIX,
        padding=DELIVERY_NUMBER_PADDING,
        on_date=delivery_date,
    )

    delivery = Delivery(
        id=delivery_id,
        tenant_id=tenant_id,
        document_id=document.id,
        delivery_number=number,
        status=DeliveryStatus.DRAFT.value,
        sales_order_id=order.id,
        customer_id=order.customer_id,
        warehouse_id=payload.warehouse_id,
        delivery_date=delivery_date,
        shipping_address=payload.shipping_address,
        notes=payload.notes,
    )
    session.add(delivery)
    for index, line in enumerate(validated, start=1):
        session.add(
            DeliveryLine(
                tenant_id=tenant_id,
                delivery_id=delivery_id,
                line_number=index,
                sales_order_line_id=line.sales_order_line_id,
                item_id=line.item_id,
                bin_id=line.bin_id,
                quantity=line.quantity,
                lot_code=line.lot_code,
                serial_code=line.serial_code,
            )
        )
    await session.flush()
    await docflow.set_document_status(
        session, tenant_id, document.id, doc_number=number, status=DeliveryStatus.DRAFT.value
    )
    return delivery


async def post_delivery(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, delivery_id: uuid.UUID
) -> Delivery:
    """Post a DRAFT delivery (PLAN 7.3, D-045) — the heart. In ONE transaction: PUBLISH
    ``DeliveryShipped`` so inventory's handler creates the stock ISSUE moves (Dr COGS / Cr Inventory,
    COGS being the default ISSUE offset — no override) and finance posts the journals; raise each
    order line's delivered_quantity; advance the order status (PARTIALLY_DELIVERED / DELIVERED); link
    docflow order→delivery; set the delivery POSTED — all here, before commit (D-011). A closed
    delivery period trips a move's COGS-journal trigger and rolls it ALL back; insufficient stock at
    a bin rolls it ALL back.

    Idempotent re-post is rejected (a POSTED delivery is terminal — corrected by a return / RMA,
    7.4). The caller commits via uow; the published event is drained in that same uow."""
    delivery = await get_delivery(session, tenant_id, delivery_id)
    status = DeliveryStatus(delivery.status)
    if status == DeliveryStatus.POSTED:
        raise ConflictError(
            message="The delivery is already posted",
            code="sales.delivery_already_posted",
            details={"delivery_id": str(delivery_id)},
        )
    if status != DeliveryStatus.DRAFT:
        raise ConflictError(
            message=f"A {delivery.status} delivery cannot be posted",
            code="sales.delivery_not_postable",
            details={"delivery_id": str(delivery_id), "status": delivery.status},
        )

    lines = await get_delivery_lines(session, tenant_id, delivery_id)
    order_lines = {
        line.id: line
        for line in await get_sales_order_lines(session, tenant_id, delivery.sales_order_id)
    }

    moves: list[DeliveryMove] = []
    for line in lines:
        order_line = order_lines[line.sales_order_line_id]
        order_line.delivered_quantity = Decimal(str(order_line.delivered_quantity)) + Decimal(
            str(line.quantity)
        )
        moves.append(
            DeliveryMove(
                item_id=line.item_id,
                bin_id=line.bin_id,
                quantity=Decimal(str(line.quantity)),
                lot_code=line.lot_code,
                serial_code=line.serial_code,
            )
        )

    await _advance_order_status(
        session, tenant_id, delivery.sales_order_id, order_lines.values()
    )

    delivery.status = DeliveryStatus.POSTED.value
    delivery.posted_at = datetime.now()
    await session.flush()
    await docflow.set_document_status(
        session, tenant_id, delivery.document_id, status=DeliveryStatus.POSTED.value
    )
    # Link order document → delivery document ('delivered_by') for the docflow chain (the delivery→
    # move edges are written by inventory's handler when it creates the moves — D-045).
    order = await session.get(SalesOrder, delivery.sales_order_id)
    if order is not None:
        await docflow.link_documents(
            session,
            tenant_id,
            predecessor=order.document_id,
            successor=delivery.document_id,
            link_type=ORDER_DELIVERED_BY_DELIVERY_LINK,
        )

    # Publish AFTER sales' own writes settle: inventory's handler creates the ISSUE moves (COGS the
    # default offset) and finance posts the COGS journals, all drained in this same uow (D-011/D-045).
    publish(
        session,
        DeliveryShipped(
            tenant_id=tenant_id,
            delivery_id=delivery.id,
            delivery_number=delivery.delivery_number,
            document_id=delivery.document_id,
            warehouse_id=delivery.warehouse_id,
            move_date=delivery.delivery_date.isoformat(),
            moves=tuple(moves),
        ),
    )
    return delivery


async def cancel_delivery(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, delivery_id: uuid.UUID
) -> Delivery:
    """Cancel a DRAFT delivery (PLAN 7.3). A POSTED delivery is TERMINAL — it has issued stock and
    posted COGS, so it is corrected by a return / RMA (7.4), never cancelled (v1 has no reverse-
    delivery; documented). Cancelling a DRAFT moves nothing."""
    delivery = await get_delivery(session, tenant_id, delivery_id)
    if DeliveryStatus(delivery.status) != DeliveryStatus.DRAFT:
        raise ConflictError(
            message=f"A {delivery.status} delivery cannot be cancelled",
            code="sales.delivery_not_cancellable",
            details={"delivery_id": str(delivery_id), "status": delivery.status},
        )
    delivery.status = DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED.value
    await session.flush()
    await docflow.set_document_status(
        session, tenant_id, delivery.document_id, status=DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED.value
    )
    return delivery


async def _advance_order_status(
    session: AsyncSession,
    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
    order_id: uuid.UUID,
    order_lines,
) -> None:
    """Advance the order status after a delivery raised the lines' delivered_quantity (PLAN 7.3):
    DELIVERED when every line is fully delivered (delivered >= ordered), else PARTIALLY_DELIVERED. The
    order + lines are already loaded/mutated in this session, so this reads the in-memory state."""
    fully_delivered = all(
        Decimal(str(line.delivered_quantity)) >= Decimal(str(line.ordered_quantity))
        for line in order_lines
    )
    order = await get_sales_order(session, tenant_id, order_id)
    new_status = (
        SalesOrderStatus.DELIVERED if fully_delivered else SalesOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_DELIVERED
    )
    order.status = new_status.value
    await session.flush()
    await docflow.set_document_status(
        session, tenant_id, order.document_id, status=new_status.value
    )

the chain to render the flow. Procurement updates its own PO received_quantity + GR status in the

"""Inventory domain-event handlers (D-011/D-041/D-045) — the cross-module document → stock-move
bridges.

TWO symmetric handlers, both the SANCTIONED cross-module mechanism (STRUCTURE §5): the owning module
must NOT import inventory's service, so it publishes a plain typed event (the only file of the owning
module this handler imports) and inventory reacts by calling its OWN ``stock_moves.create_move`` in
the SAME transaction as the publishing post (D-011 run_in_uow drains before commit). The mirror of
the existing inventory→finance pattern (inventory publishes StockValued, finance/handlers posts the
journal) — here procurement/sales publish, inventory handles.

1. ``procurement.goods_receipt.posted`` → ``receive_goods_receipt_moves``: one stock RECEIPT move per
   GR line (INBOUND). Each passes ``valuation_offset_account_id`` = the GR/IR clearing account from
   the event, so the move's costing event (StockValued) carries it as ``offset_account_id`` and
   finance's COGS handler credits GR/IR — yielding Dr Inventory / Cr GR-IR (the three-way-match's
   clearing leg) instead of the standalone price-difference offset.

2. ``sales.delivery.shipped`` → ``issue_delivery_moves``: one stock ISSUE move per delivery line
   (OUTBOUND — the twin of #1, D-045). NO ``valuation_offset_account_id`` — an ISSUE move's DEFAULT
   valuation offset IS the item-category COGS account (the costing engine routes an ISSUE to COGS),
   so the move's costing event posts Dr COGS / Cr Inventory with no override. This is the one place

async def issue_delivery_moves(session: AsyncSession, event: DeliveryShipped) -> None:
    """Create the stock ISSUE moves for a posted delivery (D-045), in the delivery's transaction —
    the OUTBOUND twin of ``receive_goods_receipt_moves``.

    One move per delivery line, each issuing FROM the line's source bin. NO
    ``valuation_offset_account_id``: an ISSUE move's default offset is the item-category COGS account
    (the costing engine routes an ISSUE to COGS), so each move's costing event posts Dr COGS / Cr
    Inventory with no override — unlike the GR/IR receipt. The costing engine COMPUTES the COGS of the
    stock that left (FIFO layers / moving-average), so no unit_cost is passed. Insufficient stock at a
    bin raises InsufficientStockError, rolling the whole delivery post back (D-020). Links the delivery
    document to each move document ('moved_by') so the docflow chain shows order → delivery → move(s).
    Registered via ``app.main.register_event_handlers`` (not an import-time ``@on``), so the test
    harness re-registers it after its per-test reset."""
    move_date = date.fromisoformat(event.move_date)
    for line in event.moves:
        move = await create_move(
            session,
            event.tenant_id,
            StockMoveCreate(
                move_type=MoveType.ISSUE,
                item_id=line.item_id,
                quantity=line.quantity,
                from_bin_id=line.bin_id,
                lot_code=line.lot_code,
                serial_code=line.serial_code,
                move_date=move_date,
                reference=event.delivery_number,
            ),
        )
        await docflow.link_documents(
            session,
            event.tenant_id,
            predecessor=event.document_id,
            successor=move.document_id,
            link_type=DELIVERY_MOVED_BY_STOCK_MOVE_LINK,

async def lot_id_for_code(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID, lot_code: str
) -> uuid.UUID | None:
    """The id of an EXISTING lot for an item, by its lot_code (PLAN 7.3), or None. A sales delivery
    (an outbound ISSUE) must reference an existing lot by id — unlike a receipt, an issue never
    creates a lot — so the delivery resolves the human ``lot_code`` to a lot id through this contract
    (D-029) before issuing. Index-served by (tenant, item_id)."""
    stmt = select(Lot.id).where(
        Lot.tenant_id == tenant_id, Lot.item_id == item_id, Lot.lot_code == lot_code
    )
    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()


async def serial_id_for_code(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID, serial_code: str
) -> uuid.UUID | None:
    """The id of an EXISTING serial for an item, by its serial_code (PLAN 7.3), or None. The serial
    twin of ``lot_id_for_code``: a delivery resolves a serial-tracked line's ``serial_code`` to a
    serial id before issuing (D-029). Index-served by (tenant, item_id)."""
    stmt = select(SerialNumber.id).where(
        SerialNumber.tenant_id == tenant_id,
        SerialNumber.item_id == item_id,
        SerialNumber.serial_code == serial_code,
    )
    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()

async def _resolve_tracking_ids(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, line: DeliveryLine
) -> tuple[uuid.UUID | None, uuid.UUID | None]:
    """Resolve a delivery line's lot/serial CODE to the inventory id an ISSUE move needs (D-045). An
    outbound issue references an existing lot/serial by id (it never creates one), so the code is
    looked up via inventory/queries; a supplied code that does not resolve fails loud (422) so the
    delivery does not post against a non-existent lot/serial. Untracked lines carry no codes ⇒
    (None, None) and the move's tracking validator accepts an item with no lot/serial."""
    lot_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
    serial_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
    if line.lot_code is not None:
        lot_id = await inventory_queries.lot_id_for_code(
            session, tenant_id, line.item_id, line.lot_code
        )
        if lot_id is None:
            raise ValidationFailedError(
                message="The referenced lot does not exist for this item",
                code="sales.delivery_lot_not_found",
                details={"item_id": str(line.item_id), "lot_code": line.lot_code},
            )
    if line.serial_code is not None:
        serial_id = await inventory_queries.serial_id_for_code(
            session, tenant_id, line.item_id, line.serial_code
        )
        if serial_id is None:
            raise ValidationFailedError(
                message="The referenced serial does not exist for this item",
                code="sales.delivery_serial_not_found",
                details={"item_id": str(line.item_id), "serial_code": line.serial_code},
            )
    return lot_id, serial_id

async def so_line_open_to_invoice(
    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, order_line_id: uuid.UUID
) -> Decimal | None:
    """The still-open-to-invoice quantity on an order line — DELIVERED minus INVOICED — or None if
    the line does not exist (PLAN 7.3 → 7.4). 7.4 bills against DELIVERED-but-not-yet-INVOICED
    quantity (you invoice what shipped, not merely what was ordered), so this caps an invoice line at
    delivered − invoiced, NOT ordered − invoiced. A point lookup on the maintained columns."""
    line = (
        await session.execute(
            select(SalesOrderLine).where(
                SalesOrderLine.tenant_id == tenant_id,
                SalesOrderLine.id == order_line_id,
            )
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if line is None:
        return None
    return Decimal(str(line.delivered_quantity)) - Decimal(str(line.invoiced_quantity))
